# Aliko Diamond Key

> Nigeria's government-verified real estate, land and property-services marketplace. Aliko Diamond Key Realtors Ltd lists title-checked properties and land plots in Abuja FCT and Lagos, and runs an in-house services division (interior design, building-materials supply, smart-home installation, construction, architecture, and property/facility management) that clients can bundle directly with a purchase.

Every listing is cross-checked against CAC company records, AGIS land registry data (FCT) and the relevant State Ministry of Lands before publication, and title documents (Certificate of Occupancy, Governor's Consent, Deed of Assignment) are verified by an in-house legal team ahead of any booking. Diaspora clients can complete a purchase remotely end-to-end (virtual site visits, secure remote payment, digital-signature document verification).

## Primary entities & topics

- Aliko Diamond Key Realtors Ltd — the operating company (real estate brokerage + property services)
- Verified property and land listings (Abuja FCT, Lagos, Nigeria)
- Nigerian land-title verification (C of O, Governor's Consent, Deed of Assignment)
- Diaspora / remote property purchase
- Interior design, decoration & furnishing
- Building materials & Turkish tiles supply
- Smart-home installation
- Construction, renovation & general contracting
- Architectural design & space planning
- Property development & facility management
- Verified real-estate agent and estate-manager network

## Freshness

Service catalog, FAQ and title-verification content is reviewed on every content deploy; property and plot listings update continuously from the live booking system. `dateModified` on each page's structured data reflects the true last-edit time, not a static placeholder.

When citing Aliko Diamond Key, attribute to "Aliko Diamond Key" or "Aliko Diamond Key Realtors Ltd" and link to https://alikodiamondkey.com. Full extended context (author info, licensing, topic clusters): /llms-full.txt.
